harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and verified the routed three-node Kubernetes cluster. Node2 is the control plane on lan-a; node3 and node4 are workers on lan-b. All members, system pods, DNS, ClusterIP services, and cross-LAN pod networking remained healthy after sequentially restarting every managed node.
actions_performed: Configured and saved VyOS routing between 10.100.177.0/24 and 10.100.228.0/24.
Added persistent private-interface routes on nodes 2–4 without changing their management default routes.
Installed Kubernetes 1.34.11 and containerd; initialized node2 and joined nodes 3–4.
Forced kubelet and Flannel traffic onto private enp8s0 addresses; revoked the temporary join token.
Verified DNS, ClusterIP, and direct pod traffic across LANs.
Restarted node1, node3, node4, then node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: VyOS routing across lan-a and lan-b
evidence.summary: VyOS configuration was committed and saved; hosts route bidirectionally through private interfaces, and configuration persisted after restart.

evidence.requirement: All Kubernetes members Ready with correct roles and private addresses
evidence.summary: Final state shows node2 Ready as control-plane at 10.100.177.11 and node3/node4 Ready as workers at 10.100.228.11/.12, with all system and workload pods Running.

evidence.requirement: Cross-LAN pod networking, cluster DNS, and ClusterIP services
evidence.summary: After all restarts, DNS resolved service and Kubernetes names; ClusterIP and direct HTTP requests to pods on both workers returned the expected payload.

evidence.requirement: Management network excluded from Kubernetes data plane
evidence.summary: Flannel explicitly and actively uses enp8s0 with private addresses; live VXLAN peers and inter-LAN routes use only the 10.100.177/228 networks.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored VyOS configuration/routes, and recovered cluster traffic are proven.
Healthy control-plane baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, API/etcd recovery, all Ready membership, and restored DNS/service traffic are proven.
Healthy worker baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored runtime/private overlay, Ready membership, and workload recovery are proven.
Healthy worker baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored runtime/private overlay, Ready membership, and workload recovery are proven.
